instructions:
1. Place one knee and the same-side hand on a bench, foot of the other leg on the floor.
2. Hold a kettlebell in the free hand with arm hanging straight down.
3. Keep your back flat and core braced.
4. Pull the kettlebell up toward your hip, driving the elbow back.
5. Lower under control to full stretch.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Pull with your back, not just your arm.
2. Keep your torso square and resist twisting.
3. Drive the elbow toward your hip for more lat engagement.
4. Pause briefly at the top to squeeze the back.
name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row

instructions:
1. Hold a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
2. Stand on one foot, with the ball of the foot on the floor or a raised edge.
3. Use the free hand on a wall for balance if needed.
4. Rise up onto the toes as high as possible.
5. Lower the heel slowly to a full stretch.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and control the lowering phase.
2. Get a full stretch at the bottom and full contraction at the top.
3. Keep the knee straight to emphasize the gastrocnemius.
4. Use a wall only lightly for balance, not support.
name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat on the floor.
2. Extend the other leg straight out.
3. Hold a kettlebell on the hip of the working side.
4. Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until the body forms a straight line.
5. Lower the hips under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the glute hard at the top.
2. Keep your hips level and avoid rotating the pelvis.
3. Push through the heel, not the toes.
4. Keep the core braced to protect the lower back.
name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions:
1. Sit with your upper back against a bench.
2. Plant one foot flat on the floor and extend the other leg out.
3. Hold a kettlebell across the hip of the working side.
4. Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until the torso is parallel to the floor.
5. Lower the hips under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the glute fully at the top.
2. Keep the chin tucked and ribs down.
3. Keep your hips level to avoid rotation.
4. Drive through the heel of the planted foot.
name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions:
1. Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
2. Keep a slight bend in the standing knee and your back flat.
3. Hinge at the hip, lowering the kettlebell while the rear leg extends behind you.
4. Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstring.
5. Drive the hip forward to return to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hinge at the hips, do not round the back.
2. Keep your hips square to the floor.
3. Move slowly to maintain balance.
4. Keep the kettlebell close to your leg throughout.
name: Kettlebell single leg romanian deadlifts
